is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates wild populations of Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Study site).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions a kdr frequency of 86.7% on page 2, but this is explicitly cited from reference [16] (Yadouleton et al. 2009). No new genotyping of resistance markers was performed or reported in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or allele frequencies with associated sample sizes are provided for the mosquitoes collected during the experimental hut trials.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Akron, Porto Novo, Benin (Page 2, Study site).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting results from experimental hut trials (Page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are tied to Akron, an outskirt of Porto Novo (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were conducted between September 2007 and January 2008 (Page 3, Figure 2; Page 6, Table 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses the same field site and population as a previous study (Yadouleton et al. 2009), but the experimental hut trials described here appear to be distinct primary data.

supplement.evidence: No mention of supplementary files containing genotype data; the paper focuses on bioassay results from experimental huts.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of bendiocarb and fenitrothion as alternatives to pyrethroids for indoor residual spraying (IRS) using experimental huts in Benin. While the study population is described as pyrethroid-resistant with a high kdr frequency, this frequency (86.7%) is cited from a previous publication (Yadouleton et al. 2009). No new genotyping data for resistance markers are reported in this paper.
exclusion_reasons: The study does not report new extractable genotype data (counts or frequencies) for the target markers; the kdr frequency mentioned is a citation of previous work (reference 16).
